Let’s break down the SVG path:  

`M 12.98,31.92 L 92.45,24.58` — moves to (12.98,31.92) then draws a line to (92.45,24.58).  

`M 92.45,24.58 L 59.03,76.23 L 12.98,31.92` — moves again to (92.45,24.58) (same point), then draws a line to (59.03,76.23), then a line to (12.98,31.92).  

So the path consists of:  
1. A line from (12.98,31.92) to (92.45,24.58)  
2. A line from (92.45,24.58) to (59.03,76.23)  
3. A line from (59.03,76.23) back to (12.98,31.92)  

That’s three distinct points connected in a closed loop with three line segments — a triangle.  

Final answer: (J)
